title: Adjusting score color (for dark/light mode) somewhat tedious
summary: I am super new to `vexflow` and am integrating it into a [starlight.astro.build](https://starlight.astro.build) site. The site by default offers dark/light mode and I want to adapt `vexflow` scores in sync. Because SVG cannot be CSS-themed (easily) with `vexflow` because `stroke`/`fill` is set on many ` ` elements independently, I am redrawing the scores on theme switch. I am using `EasyScore` and ended up fixing-up the score color like this - am I doing something wrong here? ```js function setFgColor(factory: Factory, fgColor: string) { factory.getStave()?.set```Style({ strokeStyle: fgColor, fillStyle: fgColor, }); factory.getStave()?.setDefaultLedgerLineStyle({ strokeStyle: fgColor, fillStyle: fgColor, }); factory.getVoices().forEach((voice) => { voice.setStyle({ strokeStyle: fgColor, fillStyle: fgColor, }); voice.getTickables().forEach((tickable) => { tickable.setStyle({ strokeStyle: fgColor, fillStyle: fgColor, }); }); }); } ``` My first go was to adjust `factory.getContext()` attributes but this only very partially applied colors. Stems were left in wrong color as were the stave and ledger lines. If you are interested (work-in-progress, content possibly still non-sensical): https://tvogel.github.io/informatik-2026-coding-music/exercises/01_basic_beats/
